claims.claim: ORUS 设计：1,000 名 21–40 岁、2019 年家庭收入 ≤300% FPL 的低收入者每月 $1,000 无条件发 3 年，对照 2,000 人每月 $50；样本来自伊利诺伊北部（含芝加哥）与得州北部，按 2019 年基线家庭收入约 $29,900 算相当于家庭收入 +40%。
claims.quote: Individuals between the ages of 21 and 40 whose total household income did not exceed 300% of the Federal Poverty Level (FPL) in 2019 were eligible to participate, with most of the sample falling below 100% or 200% of the FPL. Participants reported an average household income of about $29,900 in 2019, so the transfers represented a 40% increase in household income.
claims.source_title: Vivalt, Rhodes, Bartik, Broockman, Krause, Miller, 2024 (rev. 2026-08), The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States, NBER w32719 / QJE 141(4):2675-2734 (2026)
claims.notes: 局部样本、低收入定向、有期限（3 年，2020-11 至 2023-10，覆盖疫情后期与工资快速上涨期）。对照组每月也拿 $50（不是零）。预注册 AEARCTR-0006750（文中脚注 1，偏离 PAP 处见附录 G）。正式发表于 QJE 2026（NBER 页面 Published Versions 列出）。

claims.claim: ORUS 劳动供给（最终版）：转移使不含转移的个人收入每年下降约 $1,900，劳动参与率下降 4.2 个百分点（UI 行政数据+调查合并口径），每周工时减少 1–2 小时；伴侣工时减少幅度相当。
claims.quote: The transfer caused total individual income excluding the transfers to fall by about $1,900/year relative to the control group and a 4.2 percentage point decrease in labor market participation. Participants reduced their work hours as a result of the transfers by 1-2 hours/week and participants’ partners reduced their work hours by a comparable amount.
claims.source_title: Vivalt, Rhodes, Bartik, Broockman, Krause, Miller, 2024 (rev. 2026-08), The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States, NBER w32719 / QJE 141(4):2675-2734 (2026)
claims.notes: 效应量相对对照均值约 5–6%，作者称『moderate』。弹性：参与弹性 ηe=-0.20，无条件工时弹性 ηi=-0.16，条件工时弹性 -0.08。资助：NSF #2149344 + 'private donors'。 【并入】ORUS 就业质量与主观幸福感：尽管详细询问工作福利，未发现就业质量改善且可排除小幅改善；主观幸福感第一年较高、之后回到对照水平。 原文："Despite asking detailed questions about amenities, we find no impact on quality of employment, and our confidence intervals can rule out even small improvements. ... Measures of subjective well-being are higher among treated participants in the first year of the transfers but then revert to control group levels."（https://www.nber.org/system/files/working_papers/w32719/w32719.pdf）

claims.claim: ORUS 不同数据口径给出不同就业效应：调查口径就业 -2.3pp（SE 1.2），UI 行政数据单独 -6.6pp（SE 2.0），合并口径 -4.2pp（SE 1.7）；调查工时 -1.3 小时/周（SE 0.6）。
claims.quote: Treated participants appear 2.3 (s.e. 1.2) percentage points less likely to be employed in the survey data (row 2). Similar to how we saw larger impacts on income in the UI data compared to survey data, we estimate a larger effect on labor supply using the UI data: a 6.6 (s.e. 2.0) percentage point decrease in employment using the UI data alone (row 3) and a 4.2 (s.e. 1.7) percentage point decrease in employment using the pooled UI and survey data (row 4).
claims.source_title: Vivalt, Rhodes, Bartik, Broockman, Krause, Miller, 2024 (rev. 2026-08), The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States, NBER w32719 / QJE 141(4):2675-2734 (2026)
claims.notes: 自报 vs 行政数据口径差 3 倍。UI 数据不含合同工/临时工/零工，可能高估退出；调查口径可能低估。行政数据链接同意率 87.5%，匹配率 IL 71%、TX 73%。引用 ORUS 就业效应时必须说明是哪个口径。

claims.claim: ORUS 就业效应数字随版本上调：2024-07 初版摘要为劳动参与 -2.0pp、工时 -1.3~1.4 小时/周、个人收入 -$1,500/年；2025-01 版为 -3.9pp；2026-08 最终版为 -4.2pp、-$1,900/年。
claims.quote: The transfer caused total individual income to fall by about $1,500/year relative to the control group, excluding the transfers. The program resulted in a 2.0 percentage point decrease in labor market participation for participants and a 1.3-1.4 hour per week reduction in labor hours, with participants’ partners reducing their hours worked by a comparable amount.
claims.source_title: Vivalt et al., 2024-07 (初版), NBER w32719 rev0
claims.notes: 媒体与二手综述大多仍引 2024 初版的 2.0pp；2025-01 修订版（rev1）摘要为 '3.9 percentage point decrease in labor market participation'。写作时应引最终 QJE 版 4.2pp，并注明变化来自口径（加入/合并 UI 行政数据）。

claims.claim: ORUS 家庭层面：参与者+伴侣合计每周工时减少 2.1 小时（SE 0.8），全体家庭成员减少 2.4 小时（SE 0.9），约为对照均值的 4.9–5.2%；但伴侣/家庭成员结果非预注册，经 FDR 校正后不显著。
claims.quote: we estimate a reduction of 2.1 (s.e. 0.8) in total hours per week worked by the participant and their partner (row 5 of Table IV), and 2.4 (s.e. 0.9) hours per week when we include all household members (row 6). These estimates represent a 4.9-5.2% decrease relative to the control mean
claims.source_title: Vivalt, Rhodes, Bartik, Broockman, Krause, Miller, 2024 (rev. 2026-08), The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States, NBER w32719 / QJE 141(4):2675-2734 (2026)
claims.notes: 原文紧接着承认：'The estimates for the work hours of others in the household were not pre-specified and are subjected to a large penalty in the FDR corrections, but they are significant before those corrections are applied.' 伴侣效应是探索性结果。

claims.claim: ORUS 时间使用：手机 App 时间日记显示每周工作减少约 1.4 小时，释放的时间主要流向休闲、非通勤交通及其他活动；对求职、培训、照护、自我提升等『生产性』用途可排除哪怕很小的变化。
claims.quote: The extra time participants have from reduced work is used largely for leisure, non-commuting transportation, and other activities (Figure V).
claims.source_title: Vivalt, Rhodes, Bartik, Broockman, Krause, Miller, 2024 (rev. 2026-08), The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States, NBER w32719 / QJE 141(4):2675-2734 (2026)
claims.notes: 引言处另有：'We can reject even small changes in several other specific categories of time use that...' 与 'childcare, exercising, searching for a job, or self improvement'。脚注 23：社交休闲仅边际显著、独处休闲经多重检验校正后不显著。结论句：'a moderate labor supply effect that does not appear offset by other productive activities.'

claims.claim: ORUS 自报残疾上升：处理组自报任何残疾的概率高 4.3pp（对照基数 31%），自报限制工作的健康问题/残疾高 4.2pp（对照基数 28%）；作者给出『获得更多医疗而被诊断』与『自我标签以减轻不就业污名』两种解释。
claims.quote: We find a significant 4.3 percentage point increase in the likelihood of self-reporting any disability (on a base of 31 percent in the control group) and a 4.2 percentage point increase in the probability of reporting a health problem or disability that limits the work they can do (on a base of 28 percent in the control group)
claims.source_title: Vivalt, Rhodes, Bartik, Broockman, Krause, Miller, 2024 (rev. 2026-08), The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States, NBER w32719 / QJE 141(4):2675-2734 (2026)
claims.notes: 与健康论文『客观生物标志物无变化』并读：自报健康变差而客观指标不变，提示自报口径受就业状态反向影响（self-signaling）。

claims.claim: ORUS 健康：压力与食物安全大幅但短暂改善；医院/急诊/牙科使用上升、医疗支出约 +$20/月；自报身体健康、血检生物标志物无改善，精神健康第一年后无改善，可排除小效应；家中儿童健康也无效应。
claims.quote: The transfer produced large but short-lived improvements in stress and food security and increased hospital, emergency department, and dental care use. However, it did not improve self-reported physical health, clinical biomarkers, or mental health after the first year, and we can rule out small effects on many outcomes. We also find no effects on the health of children in participants’ households.
claims.source_title: Miller, Rhodes, Bartik, Broockman, Krause, Vivalt, 2024 (rev. 2026-08), Does Income Affect Health? Evidence from a Randomized Controlled Trial of a Guaranteed Income, NBER w32711
claims.notes: 2024-07 初版（https://public.websites.umich.edu/~mille/ORUS_Health.pdf）原话：'the transfer did not improve mental health after the first year and by year 2 we can again reject very small improvements'。即精神健康效应在第二年消失。2026-08 修订版致谢含 'Erzo Luttmer and four anonymous referees'，显示已进入期刊审稿，但 NBER 页未列已发表版本。资助：NIH 1R01HD108716-01A1 + 私人资金。生物标志物在 Census FSRDC 处理。

claims.claim: ORUS 政治：$1,000/月 × 3 年对政治参与、投入、偏好、政府信任、极化、民主支持均无影响，可排除与收入-投票率观测关联同量级的效应；处理组反而更倾向认为工作对个人/社会重要、甚至应作为领取政府项目的条件。
claims.quote: Contrary to resource models of participation, we find no effects on political participation or engagement, and rule out effects equivalent to the observational association between turnout and income. ... There is also some evidence that treated participants saw work as more important for individuals, society, or even as a requirement for accessing government programs
claims.source_title: Broockman, Rhodes, Bartik, Dotson, Miller, Krause, Vivalt, 2024, The Causal Effects of Income on Political Attitudes and Behavior: A Randomized Field Experiment, NBER w33214
claims.notes: 与本期『公民身份/政治议价权』直接相关：私人慈善、免税、有期限的赠款不同于政府发放的权利型转移，作者自己指出结果 'contrast with findings from other economic shocks such as government-sponsored or taxable transfers'。外推到全民、政府、永久 UBI 的政治效应须谨慎。

claims.claim: ORUS 育儿与儿童：处理组父母在子女上花费更多、自报育儿行为更好（如更密切监督），但同时自报孩子发育困难与压力更多；学校行政记录中大多数教育结果无显著效应；父母压力与精神困扰的改善在第二年消失。
claims.quote: The transfer did not have a meaningful effect on most educational outcomes measured in school administrative records ... While the transfer reduced parents’ stress and mental distress in the first year of the program, these effects were short-lived and dissipated by the second year of the transfer
claims.source_title: Krause, Rhodes, Miller, Bartik, Broockman, Vivalt, 2025 (rev. 2026-09), The Impact of Unconditional Cash Transfers on Parenting and Children, NBER w34040
claims.notes: 又一处自报 vs 行政数据张力：父母自报育儿改善，而学校行政数据无效应；作者自己指出『possibly due to this closer monitoring』父母报告孩子问题更多。

claims.claim: ORUS 发起与资助：2016 年 Sam Altman 以 YC 名义发布首个 Request for Research，要资助一项『给人足够生活的钱、无附加条件』的基本收入研究，动机明确与技术替代工作有关。
claims.quote: We’d like to fund a study on basic income—i.e., giving people enough money to live on with no strings attached. ... I’m fairly confident that at some point in the future, as technology continues to eliminate traditional jobs and massive new wealth gets created, we're going to see some version of this at a national scale.
claims.source_title: Sam Altman, 2016, Basic Income, Y Combinator Blog
claims.notes: 利益关联：出资方有明确政策立场。论文本身只写 'private donors'/'generous private funding sources'。媒体报道的具体金额（Altman 约 $14M、Jack Dorsey 的 Start Small 约 $15M、OpenAI 非营利部门约 $10M 等）未找到一手（990 税表未核），属 secondhand。值得注意的是出资方立场与结果方向相反（结果不利于 UBI 叙事），降低了『出资人操纵结论』的疑虑；且预注册+NBER/QJE 同行评审。

claims.claim: Stockton SEED：131 人处理组每月 $500、200 人对照，2019-02 至 2021-01 共 24 个月；处理组收入波动更低、精神困扰更低、精力与身体功能更好。
claims.quote: A mixed-methods randomized controlled trial in Stockton, CA, USA enrolled 131 individuals to the treatment condition and 200 to control to receive a guaranteed income from February 2019 to January 2021. ... The treatment condition reported lower rates of income volatility than control, lower mental distress, better energy and physical functioning
claims.source_title: West & Castro, 2023, Impact of Guaranteed Income on Health, Finances, and Agency: Findings from the Stockton Randomized Controlled Trial, Journal of Urban Health 100:227–244 (doi:10.1007/s11524-023-00723-0)
claims.notes: 局部（收入 ≤ 斯托克顿家庭中位数 $46,033 的普查区）、有期限、n 极小。全部结果为自报（SF-36、K10、SMS 自报月收入）。研究资助：RWJF Evidence for Action + Economic Security Project（UBI 倡导组织）；发放资金来自私人捐赠。前市长 Tubbs 为项目发起人。有预分析计划（文内引 [26]）。 【并入】SEED 统计效力严重受限：作者承认样本量受成本限制，终期保留率仅约对照 35%、处理 55%（因指标而异），另有 14 人『政治性目的组』被剔除。 原文："By endline, retention was approximately 35% in control and 55% in treatment dependent upon outcome measure."（https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC10160253）

claims.claim: SEED 就业：常被引用的『全职就业率翻倍』来自第一年初步报告；同行评审终稿中疫情前一年从失业转就业的趋势不显著（ANCOVA p=0.183），疫情期间与停发后也无显著效应。
claims.quote: Preliminary reporting noted a substantial increase in full and part-time employment among the treatment group during year one [30]. Trend data in the pre-pandemic year of the experiment show substantial shifts from unemployment to employment (full time, part time, or as a caregiver) from baseline to Wave 4, but were not statistically significant. Further observation during the pandemic, as well as after withdrawal of the intervention did not show significant effects on employment
claims.source_title: West & Castro, 2023, Impact of Guaranteed Income on Health, Finances, and Agency: Findings from the Stockton Randomized Controlled Trial, Journal of Urban Health 100:227–244 (doi:10.1007/s11524-023-00723-0)
claims.notes: 就业变量把『居家照护者』编码为就业=1，口径宽。Table 8 各时段 F 检验 p=0.183 / 0.612 / 0.909。疫情从第 13 个月起干扰全部第二年数据。

claims.claim: Baby's First Years：1,000 名收入低于贫困线的母亲产后被随机分到每月 $333 或 $20；4 年后（n=891）四项预注册主要结果（语言、执行功能、社会情绪问题、高频脑电）与三项次要结果均无显著效应。
claims.quote: After the first four years of the intervention (n=891), we find no statistically significant impacts of the cash transfers on four preregistered primary outcomes (language, executive function, social-emotional problems, and high-frequency brain activity) nor on three secondary outcomes (visual processing/spatial perception, pre-literacy, maternal reports of developmental diagnoses).
claims.source_title: Noble, Magnuson, Duncan, Gennetian, Yoshikawa, Fox, Halpern-Meekin, Troller-Renfree et al., 2025, The Effect of a Monthly Unconditional Cash Transfer on Children's Development at Four Years of Age: A Randomized Controlled Trial in the U.S., NBER w33844
claims.notes: 局部（纽约、新奥尔良、明尼阿波利斯-圣保罗、奥马哈 12 家医院）、低收入定向、有期限（延长至 76 个月）。对照也拿 $20。预注册 NCT03593356。资助方三十余家（NICHD R01HD087384、HHS OPRE、Gates、CZI、Arnold Ventures、Robin Hood 等）。约等于家庭收入 +18%，转移强度弱于 ORUS。计划 6 岁、8 岁随访。

claims.claim: BFY 1 岁脑电（2022）曾报告高现金组婴儿高频 EEG 功率更高，但显著性随设定变化；4 岁随访（2026）预注册主要与次要脑电结果均为零，只有探索性 alpha 功率差异。
claims.quote: We find no impact on our primary preregistered outcome (an aggregated index of mid-to-high-frequency brain activity) or our secondary preregistered outcome frontal gamma power.
claims.source_title: BFY team, 2026, The impact of a monthly unconditional cash transfer on child brain activity: A 4-year follow-up, Developmental Cognitive Neuroscience
claims.notes: 对照 2022 PNAS（Troller-Renfree et al., doi:10.1073/pnas.2115649119, n=435 子样本）：'Indeed, infants in the high-cash gift group showed more power in high-frequency bands' 但 'the significance of estimates varied with the analytic specification'。早期阳性在随访中未复现，是典型『早期信号衰减』。

claims.claim: BFY 健康（JAMA Pediatrics 2025）：4 年累计约 $15,000 的转移未改善母亲抑郁、焦虑、BMI，也未改善儿童 BMI 百分位与母亲报告的儿童健康。
claims.quote: No statistically detectable group differences were found in maternal depressive symptoms (effect size [ES], 0.04; 95% CI, -0.08 to 0.17; P = .51), anxiety (ES, 0.12; 95% CI, -0.02 to 0.25; P = .09), or BMI (ES, -0.06; 95% CI, -0.21 to 0.09; P = .42).
claims.source_title: BFY team, 2025, Cash Transfers and Their Effect on Maternal and Young Children's Health: A Randomized Clinical Trial, JAMA Pediatrics
claims.notes: 作者给出三种解释之一：'an 18% increase in income is insufficient to overcome the structural vulnerabilities'。与 ORUS 精神健康第一年后消失方向一致。

claims.claim: BFY 母亲劳动供给：前四年无统计可检测的参与率或家庭收入差异；疫情高峰期（2020–21）转移似乎减少了母亲工时。
claims.quote: We find no overall statistically detectable differences in whether mothers participated in the paid workforce or on total household earnings. Receipt of the cash transfer appears to have reduced hours of maternal work during the height of the pandemic in 2020-21.
claims.source_title: Sauval, Duncan, Gennetian, Magnuson, Fox, Noble, Yoshikawa, 2024, Unconditional Cash Transfers and Maternal Employment: Evidence from the Baby's First Years Study, Journal of Public Economics
claims.notes: UChicago IEL 综述补充：样本量下 'these null effects are not precise enough to rule out small effects, but they can rule out moderate or large effects'。

claims.claim: Compton Pledge（RCT，学术独立评估）：695 户随机获得平均约 $500/月 × 2 年，1,402 户对照（不拿钱）；全职者劳动供给无变化，但基线兼职者劳动参与下降 13pp；不含转移收入每月少 $333；住房安全改善，但心理与财务福祉指数总体无效应。
claims.quote: Receiving guaranteed income had no impact on the labor supply of full-time workers, but part-time workers (at baseline) had lower labor market participation by 13 percentage points. Income (excluding the transfer) was reduced by $333 per month on average relative to control households, and expenditures were reduced by $302 per month. ... We find a significant improvement in housing security, but no overall effects on indices of psychological and financial well-being.
claims.source_title: Balakrishnan, Chan, Constantino, Haushofer, Morduch, 2024, Household Responses to Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Compton, California, NBER w33209
claims.notes: 2021–2023 疫情期；18 个月后调查 1,074 人，IEL 称响应率 51%（无差异性流失）。自报数据为主。项目由 Jain Family Institute 参与设计；学术顾问含 Evelyn Forget、Greg Duncan。

claims.claim: Denver Basic Income Project（面向无家可归者，RCT 三臂：A $1,000/月、B $6,500 一次性+$500/月、C $50/月作对照）：官方年报宣称『所有组』住房显著改善——即包括只拿 $50 的对照组，说明报告的是组内前后变化而非组间处理效应。
claims.quote: All payment groups showed significant improvements in housing outcomes, including a remarkable increase in home rent and ownership, and decrease in nights spent unsheltered.
claims.source_title: Denver Basic Income Project, 2024, Year One Research Report Executive Summary (research led by University of Denver Center for Housing and Homelessness Research)
claims.notes: 最典型的『对照组也拿钱+组内前后比』陷阱：组间差异微小（媒体转述 10 个月时稳定住房 A/B 48% vs C 46%，secondhand）。报告称研究由丹佛大学『independently』主导，但执行摘要由项目方发布、措辞为倡导式（'incredibly promising'）。自报为主，调查响应率随时间下降（媒体称 10 个月约 60%，secondhand）。

claims.claim: UChicago Inclusive Economy Lab（受 Cook County 委托评估 Cook County Promise：$500/月 × 2 年、3,250 人、ARPA 出资 $4,200 万）在汇总中只把 ORUS、BFY、Compton 列为『最严格』研究，并直言倡导者常只挑积极结果；Cook County 本身的因果评估结果尚未在其页面发布。
claims.quote: While advocates often highlight the more positive or exciting findings, it is critical to understand the full set of results and learn from pilots that find no impact or had unexpected results in order to better inform the field and policy.
claims.source_title: University of Chicago Inclusive Economy Lab, 2025, Policymakers' Report (Cook County Promise Guaranteed Income Pilot)
claims.notes: 筛选标准：RCT、预注册、样本足够、无差异性流失、2020 后发表。Cook County Promise 是抽签 RCT（23 万+申请抢 3,250 名额），但评估方受县政府委托、评估资金来自 Kellogg、Rockefeller、J-PAL 等，结果尚未出。日期 2025-10 依二手检索结果，PDF 内无明确日期。

claims.claim: 1968–82 四个负所得税实验（NJ、Rural、Gary、SIME/DIME）汇总：丈夫（主要收入者）报告工时减少约 7%，妻子与单亲女户主减少约 17%；减少主要来自就业间隔变长、失业期变长与退出劳动力，而非在职者缩短周工时。
claims.quote: Husbands reduced their reported work effort by approximately 7 percent, while wives and female heads reduced reported hours by 17 percent.
claims.source_title: Gary Burtless, 1986, The Work Response to a Guaranteed Income: A Survey of Experimental Evidence, in Munnell (ed.), Lessons from the Income Maintenance Experiments, FRB Boston Conference Series No. 30
claims.notes: 这是『reported』工时，样本加权（夫妻：NJ 0.20、Rural 0.07、Gary 0.17、SIME/DIME 0.56）。各实验保障水平为贫困线 50%–135%，边际税率 30%–70%，与今天的 UBI 无退坡设计不同。资助：联邦 HEW/OEO。

claims.claim: NIT 自报偏差与期限效应双向：Gary 与 SIME/DIME 中，用 UI 行政数据核对后，妻子（次要收入者）的收入减少『几乎消失』；但 SIME/DIME 五年组的反应约为三年组两倍（丈夫工时 -13%，妻子 -27%，单亲母亲 -32%），说明有期限实验会低估永久方案效应。
claims.quote: The earnings reduction of wives, for example, virtually disappears when the response estimate is based on presumably accurate data from the unemployment insurance system.
claims.source_title: Gary Burtless, 1986, The Work Response to a Guaranteed Income: A Survey of Experimental Evidence, in Munnell (ed.), Lessons from the Income Maintenance Experiments, FRB Boston Conference Series No. 30
claims.notes: 同文：'The bias in the Gary experiment was large enough so that the entire earnings response and much of the apparent employment effect of the experiment disappeared'；以及 'the sluggishness of the labor supply response and the attenuated response to a shorter duration plan cause the long-term impact of a permanent negative income tax to be substantially understated'。注意 Burtless 也指出临时实验是『a sale on leisure』可能反向夸大。与 ORUS『行政数据效应更大』方向相反，口径陷阱不能一概而论。

claims.claim: SIME/DIME 离婚效应被重估：Hannan、Tuma、Groeneveld 1977 年起报告 NIT 增加婚姻解体；Cain & Wissoker 重新分析（区分纯 NIT 与培训处理、用全时段、处理流失与复合）后结论是对婚姻解体率无影响。
claims.quote: The conclusion of this paper is that the plans (specifically, the negative income tax plans in the experiment) had no effect on the rate of marital dissolutions among the "treatment" couples relative to the control couples. The control couples were eligible for the existing program, Aid to Families with Dependent Children.
claims.source_title: Glen G. Cain & Douglas A. Wissoker, 1988, A Reanalysis of Marital Stability in the Seattle-Denver Income Maintenance Experiment, IRP Discussion Paper 857-88 (published AJS 95(5), 1990)
claims.notes: 引语取自 IRP 工作论文版（PDF 字距错乱，已人工复原），AJS 1990 正式版付费墙未读；同期 AJS 刊出 Hannan & Tuma 回应（doi:10.1086/229429）。对照组不是『零』而是现行 AFDC。原离婚发现曾在 1970s 末国会福利改革辩论中被广泛引用（secondhand）。

claims.claim: Dauphin Mincome（加拿大，1974–79，非美国）：Forget 2011 用卫生行政数据与准实验匹配对照，报告参与者相对对照住院率下降 8.5%，尤其事故伤害与精神健康。
claims.quote: it uses routinely collected health administration data and a quasi-experimental design to document an 8.5 percent reduction in the hospitalization rate for participants relative to controls, particularly for accidents and injuries and mental health.
claims.source_title: Evelyn L. Forget, 2011, The Town with No Poverty: The Health Effects of a Canadian Guaranteed Annual Income Field Experiment, Canadian Public Policy 37(3):283–305
claims.notes: Dauphin 为饱和站点（全镇可申领），无随机对照；对照为马尼托巴其他地区匹配样本。Forget 本人 2012 简报另一表述称 8.5% 是起始差距收敛（secondhand，未核原文）。

claims.claim: Green（2022）重估 Forget 2011：住院数据在 Dauphin 相对对照存在显著负向前趋势，考虑前趋势后标准设定下数据若有任何指向，反而是 Mincome 增加了住院使用；结论是 Mincome 数据不支持保障收入降低医疗成本。
claims.quote: I reassess the hospital use data from Forget (2011), arguing that it contains statistically significant negative pre-trends in the relative hospital usage in the treated community of Dauphin compared to comparison communities. The pre-trend combined with short prior and treatment periods raises serious issues about the usefulness of the data, which, if anything shows positive effects of MINCOME on hospital usage in standard specifications.
claims.source_title: David A. Green, 2022, A Reanalysis of "The Town with No Poverty", Canadian Public Policy 48(4):539–548
claims.notes: 工作论文版（https://economics.ubc.ca/wp-content/uploads/sites/38/2021/03/forget-cpp-reanalysis.pdf）措辞更强：'the data point to an increase in hospital use during MINCOME. This is the opposite of the conclusion reached in Forget(2011).' Forget 在同期 549–556 页有回应（未读，付费墙）。『-8.5% 住院率』是被广泛转引但已被同行重估质疑的数字。

claims.claim: Calnitsky & Latner（2017）首次分析 Dauphin 档案调查数据（DiD）：劳动市场参与下降 11.3pp，其中近 30%（约 3.1pp）归因于『社区情境』效应；退出主要集中于年轻人和单亲户，自述原因为照护、残疾疾病、就业机会不均、教育投资。
claims.quote: Using hitherto unanalyzed data we find an 11.3 percentage point reduction in labor market participation, and nearly 30 percent of that fall can be attributed to "community context" effects. Additionally, we show that withdrawals were driven disproportionately by young and single-headed households.
claims.source_title: David Calnitsky & Jonathan P. Latner, 2017, Basic Income in a Small Town: Understanding the Elusive Effects on Work, Social Problems 64(3):373–397
claims.notes: 纠正『Mincome 无劳动数据』的说法：有调查档案，Calnitsky 等用了。设计为 DiD（Dauphin 前后 vs 马尼托巴对照），自报调查数据。11.3pp 的分母是参加 Mincome 调查的样本而非全镇居民（secondhand 提示，需核表）。饱和站点揭示社区溢出效应，这是分散抽样 RCT（ORUS 等）结构上看不到的。

claims.claim: 东部切罗基赌场分红（永久、无条件、全体成年部落成员、约 $4,000/年、每半年发放）：Akee 等用 Great Smoky Mountains 儿童纵向调查做 DiD，发现最贫困家庭额外 $4,000/年使子女 21 岁时教育多 1 年、16–17 岁轻罪率下降 22%；父母未减少工作时间。
claims.quote: The additional income may allow the poorer households to substitute away from full-time employment towards part-time employment thus allowing for more child care. This does not appear to happen in our data; parents do not reduce their working time.
claims.source_title: Akee, Copeland, Keeler, Angold, Costello, 2010, Parents' Incomes and Children's Outcomes: A Quasi-experiment Using Transfer Payments from Casino Profits, AEJ: Applied Economics 2(1):86–115
claims.notes: 是本线唯一『永久』转移，但局部（北卡西部 11 县，GSMS 样本 1,420 名儿童，其中美洲原住民子样本）。教育效应有混杂：原文 'American Indian children had an incentive to finish high school by age 18 as they became eligible for payment ... otherwise they would have to wait until age 21'，即带有条件现金转移成分。父母劳动供给结论来自『各波次是否就业』，不是精细工时数据。资助：NIDA/NIMH 等（GSMS）。

open_questions: ORUS 资助金额与出资人构成（Altman 个人、OpenAI 非营利部门、Dorsey/Start Small、Sijbrandij）只在媒体报道中见到；未核 OpenResearch 的 IRS 990 一手。
ORUS 健康论文（w32711）2026-08 修订版致谢提到编辑 Erzo Luttmer 与审稿人，但截至今天 NBER 页面未列正式发表期刊；ORUS 政治论文 w33214 也未见正式发表版。
ORUS 就业结果的第三年分年度效应是否扩大或缩小（转移末期 vs 早期）未在本线逐表核对；停发后的劳动供给随访尚无。
Cook County Promise 与 Chicago Resilient Communities 的因果（处理-对照）结果：IEL 页面截至今天只有过程评估、描述性快照、经济影响分析与综述，未见出炉的 RCT 结果。
Magnolia Mother's Trust（Jackson）未纳入：其评估由执行方 Springboard to Opportunities 自评为主，未找到独立 RCT 一手报告，时间不够未深挖。
Denver Basic Income Project 完整的 Year One 定量报告与第二年报告的组间（A/B vs C）统计检验表未取到，只读了执行摘要；组间差（48% vs 46%）是媒体转述。
Cain & Wissoker AJS 1990 正式版及 Hannan & Tuma 回应、Forget 2022 对 Green 的回应均在付费墙后（Chicago Journals / UTP），未读全文。
Robins 1985 (JHR) 四个 NIT 实验比较与 SRI 1983 SIME/DIME 最终报告未直接核，NIT 数字均来自 Burtless 1986 二次汇总（其本身为一手学术综述）。
Forget 2011 全文付费墙（UTP），只读到 IDEAS 摘要；8.5% 是『相对对照下降』还是『起始差距收敛』的两种表述需全文表格判定。
Calnitsky & Latner 11.3pp 的分母（参加者 vs 全镇）需核表；Calnitsky, Latner & Forget 2019 Social Science History 关于非就业活动的论文未读。
BFY 的 ORUS 式行政数据（学校记录、UI）尚无；6 岁随访结果未发布。
